daily.title: Key takeaways from UK-EU summit: Idea of Britain rejoining still on table
daily.summary: Leaders from Britain and the European Union say they have agreed several new deals in Brussels, as the United Kingdom's Prime Minister Andy Burnham attempts to reshape his country's relationship with its closest neighbours.

daily.title: Russia pummels Ukraine after Putin vowed revenge, killing eight
daily.summary: Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, hours after President Vladimir Putin had vowed a "painful" response for Kyiv's strikes on the Crimean bridge this week.

daily.title: Teen shot dead by police was not 'just a terrorist', mother tells inquest
daily.summary: The inquest into the police shooting death of James Holland, after he stabbed a stranger, hears from his mother, who says he was vulnerable and is dearly missed.

daily.title: Myanmar calls international court ruling on Rohingya genocide 'unfair'
daily.summary: A government spokesperson says the decision by the International Court of Justice was not unanimous and Myanmar was unjustly accused.

daily.title: Lions disrupt high school graduation ceremony with consecutive picks
daily.summary: Brisbane selects a pair of schoolmates inside the space of a few minutes, interrupting their high school graduation ceremony before a third student is drafted later on night two of the AFL draft.

daily.title: Coroner reopens investigation into Victorian police officer's suicide
daily.summary: Shona O'Connor's family had demanded a public inquest be held to investigate allegations of a toxic culture within the force raised by Four Corners.

daily.title: Qld jockey loses bid to reduce jail time after strangling woman
daily.summary: A prominent Queensland jockey who admitted to strangling a woman until she saw "stars", has lost his bid to appeal his sentence.

daily.title: Teenager arrested after plea for information about 'Onepercent' profile
daily.summary: Detectives last month called for information about who was behind the handle as they investigated a series of firebombings and extortions on bars, clubs and restaurants in Melbourne.

daily.title: Lloyd Rayney files legal action against Facebook giant Meta
daily.summary: The former Perth barrister is seeking to compel the tech giant to disclose the identities of people who may have been involved in defamatory Facebook comments about him.

daily.title: Australian Rohingya hope world will listen after UN court's genocide ruling
daily.summary: Rohingya Australians welcome the International Court of Justice's judgement that Myanmar committed genocide against the Muslim minority group but say the decision must be backed up by action from the international community including Australia.

daily.title: Police warn rock-throwing targeting cars in WA could be fatal
daily.summary: A Kununurra resident says she has been left hundreds of dollars out of pocket after a group of children threw what is believed to be a large rock at her car.

daily.title: Controversial birthing model abandoned after community backlash
daily.summary: A birthing-model trial in South Australia's Mid North has been abandoned one month after it began, after a significant community backlash.

daily.title: A third of David Jones staff told employment ends days after Christmas
daily.summary: More than 1,600 David Jones staff have been issued with redundancy notices after the iconic retailer went into voluntary administration earlier this month

daily.title: Three men charged over allegedly forcing man into dog cage in Wadeye
daily.summary: Northern Territory Police have charged three men in the remote community of Wadeye for allegedly assaulting a man and holding him overnight in a dog cage, with a video of the incident recently coming to light.

daily.title: Man charged with murder of 71-year-old woman at Whitsunday home
daily.summary: The man remains in police custody and will appear before the Proserpine Magistrates Court in December.

daily.title: Police investigate council staffer's alleged $30k credit card fraud
daily.summary: The Glenelg Shire Council alleges a former staff member misused council money after calling in a forensic investigator to examine accounts.

daily.title: Calls for One Nation candidate to withdraw from election over misconduct
daily.summary: Anti-violence campaigners say One Nation candidate Garner Smith should not be running in the Victorian election after breaching five standards of conduct while a Gannawarra councillor.

daily.title: Teen to stand trial over Cairns high school stabbing
daily.summary: A 15-year-old boy accused of stabbing a fellow student with a knife during a fight at their high school in July has been committed to stand trial.

daily.title: Cricketers' association slams 'disgraceful' treatment of Sandpapergate players
daily.summary: The head of the Australian Cricketers' Association has urged people to consider the human element of the story, branding the "hounding" of some players outside their homes as "absolutely disgraceful".

daily.title: Adelaide father and son found guilty of stabbing murder
daily.summary: A Supreme Court jury has found Adelaide father and son Brian and Liam Slann guilty of murdering 21-year-old William Holdback.

daily.title: Ukraine's destruction of Putin's prized bridge a 'major hit to war effort'
daily.summary: One expert says Ukraine's destruction of the Crimean Bridge marked a "huge blow to Putin's credibility as Russian leader" in a war his country appears to be losing.

daily.title: Police confirm no evidence to support reported attempted abduction of NT student
daily.summary: Northern Territory Police have confirmed there is no evidence to suggest a previously reported attempted abduction occurred near Nightcliff Primary School yesterday afternoon.

daily.title: Lawyer denies teacher's 17-year-old sexual assault victim was a child
daily.summary: A court has heard Hunter Valley teacher Zoe Jade Hodges was warned about inappropriate behaviour before sexually abusing her 17-year-old student.

daily.title: Fifth Melbourne Cup revealed as stolen after 'staggering' heists
daily.summary: The ABC can reveal a fifth Melbourne Cup was stolen from Flemington several years ago and has never been found, as the Victoria Racing Club comes under fire by racing insiders over cup carnival security measures.

daily.title: 'Completely flattened': Farmers count their losses after wild storm
daily.summary: Shed doors were blown off and crops wiped out during a "rare" storm supercell that damaged major electricity transmission towers on South Australia's Eyre Peninsula.

developing.title: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon explains why he threw Baird's phone off bridge
developing.summary: Beau Lamarre-Condon's murder trial is continuing, after the jury was sent home early yesterday for a legal issue to be discussed.

developing.title: Live: Vic Liberals apologise after dumping candidate over anti-Aboriginal comments
developing.summary: The Victorian Liberals are today dealing with the fallout of being forced to dump Williamstown candidate Paul Lindemann over offensive social media posts. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Victorian election campaign rolls on as parties appeal to regions
developing.summary: Liberal leader Jess Wilson was spotted pouring beers in Wodonga last night, while the Carroll government has promised to freeze a tax on farmers if re-elected.

developing.title: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon answers questions in double murder trial
developing.summary: Beau Lamarre-Condon is continuing to answer questions after close to a week of cross-examination from the Crown.

developing.title: Live: Cummins hits out at Khawaja claims as 'complete and utter nonsense'
developing.summary: Australia Test captain Pat Cummins is speaking to the media at Cricket NSW's headquarters about Usman Khawaja's recent revelations about Australia's ball tampering in 2018. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: All US departing flights grounded due to communication issues
developing.summary: Flights departing from across the US have been grounded, following a national order from the country's aviation body. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Jillaroos dominating World Cup final as Chapman leaps for stunning try
developing.summary: The Jillaroos and Kangaroos take on their New Zealand rivals in the women's and men's Rugby League World Cup finals. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Unions, industry join forces to call for passage of gas reservation scheme
developing.summary: Unions and businesses groups sign an open letter calling for the federal parliament to back the government's proposed gas reservation scheme. Follow live.
